purpose: Publication planning and source selection only; no manuscript, figures, model calibration or simulation dispatch.

panels.role: Current model geometry and comparison contract
panels.boundary: Rigid sphere/prolate representation; do not substitute the historical 37-node fibre method.

panels.role: Finite numerical screening, not empirical validation
panels.boundary: Screening allowances are not confidence intervals or rigorous asymptotic error bounds. Runtime comes from the bound records, not from a population-cost extrapolation.

Before drawing a trajectory, confirm the history-column schema and whether the continued fibre record includes earlier segments. Both terminal statuses are present_at_horizon; neither is a population release estimate.

panels.role: Experimental hydraulic context, no current simulation overlay
panels.boundary: Keep material/condition panels separate. Use K_over_K0, preserve the unavailable point, distinguish SD from digitisation sensitivity, and do not count repeated controls as independent.

panels.role: Separate fibre trapping and sphere breakthrough literature panels
panels.boundary: Trapping uses analysed-fibre counts. Breakthrough uses C_over_C0; bulk_column_volumes_Qt_over_AL is not pore volumes. No integral recovery from the partial marker subset.

excluded_from_current_result_claims: Legacy Stage31 hydraulic ratios as requalified simulation predictions
A population-release or flow-response trend inferred from one short-time start
Historical fixed-fibre hydraulics described as current moving-prolate transport
PET treatment images presented as new hydraulic experiments or a chemical degradation calibration
Experimental predictive accuracy, model superiority, or first-ever fibre simulation
